route_guardian_loader.label: PMP Current Route Guardian Loader v14

current_app.label: PMP Current v12 with close-launcher Route Guardian Last Good

user_facing_rule: Only show PMP Current / PMP-CURRENT-1 as the app version.
home_screen_rule: Install pmp-app-current.html once. It is a stable map-driven door and should change as little as possible.
update_rule: Current v12 keeps the true same-shell Continuous Run Dashboard screen, same-shell Safe Writer, and same-shell Route Guardian Last Good screen. When Route Guardian Last Good is opened, the Launcher and Resident drawers are closed automatically. Route Guardian state still does the protection work; the same-shell screen is only the visual shell for normal use. The standalone pmp-route-guardian-last-good-v18.html remains protected recovery fallback. This does not change Recovery Tools, Packet 1.5, or free-only gates.
